classification.difficultyReason: The source Mastery question requires identifying parallel sides and perpendicular separation in differently oriented trapeziums, then solving for an unknown length.

content.prompt: Work out the length of each unknown side, if the area is $210\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}$.

spec.description: Sideways trapezium with vertical parallel sides, external dimension arrows and an internal horizontal dimension arrow.
spec.mathematics: The parallel sides are 30 cm and 10 cm. Their perpendicular separation is x cm. Coordinates reproduce the source arrangement rather than a measurement scale.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens and unknown x are visible; the supplied answer is stored separately.

spec.description: Trapezium with horizontal parallel sides, a sloping left side, a vertical right side and right-angle marks at both right corners.
spec.mathematics: The upper parallel side is 30 cm, the lower parallel side is y cm and the perpendicular height is 10 cm. Dimension arrows remain outside the figure.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens and unknown y are visible; the supplied answer is stored separately.

spec.description: Rotated trapezium with a long left sloping side and a parallel shorter right sloping side, connected by an approximately horizontal bottom edge and a descending upper edge.
spec.mathematics: The parallel sides are 10 cm and z cm. The internal 30 cm dimension is their perpendicular separation, derived by projecting a point on the left parallel side onto the right parallel side. No parallel marks or right-angle marks are added.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens and unknown z are visible; the supplied answer is stored separately.

answer.worked:
The parallel sides are $10\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $z\,\mathrm{cm}$; their perpendicular separation is $30\,\mathrm{cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\210&=\frac{30(10+z)}{2}\\420&=30(10+z)\\14&=10+z\\4&=z\end{align*}$$
$z=4\,\mathrm{cm}$.
